tools.description:
Report how long synthesis and the playback queue are actually taking.

        The two waits are separate on purpose: synthesis is parallel work,
        while the playback queue is a serial resource. A null summary means
        nothing has been measured yet rather than zero.
tools.name: speech_metrics

CacheUsage.title: CacheUsage

DurationSummary.description: A bounded sample of durations, in milliseconds.
DurationSummary.title: DurationSummary

QueueDepth.description: How much work is waiting in each queue.

outputSchema.description:
What the daemon can say about its own responsiveness.

The two waits are reported separately because they mean different things:
synthesis is parallel work, and the queue is a serial resource that no
amount of parallelism helps. ``None`` means nothing has been measured yet,
which a caller must be able to tell from "it was instant".
outputSchema.title: SpeechMetrics
